risks.title: Prints arrival delay
risks.description: JM Die customer prints required for supervised training pairs may arrive later than expected or not at all
risks.mitigation: U-LPR-STALL-PRINTS bypass at T+5 days → corpus-only training path
risks.trigger: No prints received by Phase 5 start + 5 days

risks.title: 3D collision simulation owner unavailable
risks.description: External 3D sim owner may not be available to integrate contract or provide simulator access
risks.mitigation: U-LPR-STALL-SIM bypass at T+3 days → synthetic sim via existing CollisionSimulationEngine
risks.trigger: 3D sim integration not started by Phase 5 + 3 days

risks.title: JM Die MOU signing delay
risks.description: Legal review and MOU signing may take longer than expected, blocking wet-run
risks.mitigation: U-LPR-STALL-MOU at T+10 days → dry-run-only gate; deferred wet-run unit to post-MS0
risks.trigger: MOU unsigned by Phase 8 start + 10 days

risks.title: KMS / HSM procurement delay
risks.description: HSM FIPS 140-2 L3 procurement or cloud KMS setup may take weeks
risks.mitigation: Start procurement in Phase 0; use software KMS (Vault dev mode) for dev/staging until HSM ready
risks.trigger: HSM not provisioned by Phase 9 U-LPR-SEC02 start

risks.title: External pen-test vendor scheduling
risks.description: 2-day pen-test may have multi-week lead time; findings may require rework
risks.mitigation: Schedule pen-test at Phase 9 start (parallel with other SEC units); reserve 2 sessions for remediation
risks.trigger: Pen-test not scheduled by Phase 9 start + 7 days

risks.title: Context-switch overhead for parallel phases
risks.description: Running Phase 9/10/11 parallel with 2-8 may cause 20-30% efficiency loss from context switching
risks.mitigation: 8 checkpoints for context preservation; assign parallel phases to dedicated sessions when possible

risks.title: Compaction loss at session boundaries
risks.description: Context compaction may lose critical state between sessions, causing rework
risks.mitigation: 8 CKPT handoffs with explicit state artifacts; /compact quick before session end; MEMORY.md auto-sync
risks.trigger: Session ends without checkpoint after complex phase

risks.title: LoRA inference SLO breach
risks.description: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B inference may exceed 1500ms p95 target on available hardware
risks.mitigation: Dual deployment path: consumer GPU (Q4_K_M + speculative) OR server GPU (A10/L4 async queue); fallback to smaller model
risks.trigger: LoRA inference p95 > 2000ms on target hardware

risks.title: Operator availability for wet-run validation
risks.description: Need ≥3 operators × ≥10 parts for statistical validity; operators have day jobs
risks.mitigation: Schedule wet-runs during low-production periods; compensate operator time; spread across 2 weeks
risks.trigger: <3 operators available for pilot validation window

risks.title: Scrap budget overrun
risks.description: Wet-run failures may exceed $8k hard floor + $12k contingency ($20k total)
risks.mitigation: Wet-run FSM with WET_SOFT_FAIL loop (max 2 retries per part); insurance rider $50k-$500k for spindle damage

risks.title: Universal Phase 0 incomplete
risks.description: W1-W2 (Enforcement, Awareness, Registry Locks, Auto-Wiring, Orphan Detection) may not be fully complete
risks.mitigation: U-LPR00a verification gate; confirm status with user before proceeding
risks.resolution_note: W1-W5 documented complete in RALPH_VALIDATION_W1-W5.md (2026-02-10); Universal Phase 0 auto-confirmed

risks.title: Okuma OSP native dialect coverage incomplete
risks.description: LAP/LAW cycles, VNOM/VC1 variables, G85/G86/G87 may not be fully covered in parser
risks.mitigation: U-LPR-PARSER-TESTS with explicit Okuma OSP coverage; soft recommendation from R3 Lathe Expert scrutiny
risks.trigger: Parser fails on >5% of JM Die .MIN files due to OSP-native constructs
